fields.Name: IT165 - Task Graph Security and Saga
fields.Description: Exercises task-graph security envelopes, saga compensation claims, the A2A task store's row boundary, and live dispatcher taint gating with compensation against real MJ: Tasks rows (deterministic, mutating, self-cleaning). TGS1: a submitted graph's parent and every child carry the submitting run's envelope in Task.SecurityEnvelope, and an edit to it on an existing row is refused while an ordinary edit saves. TGS2: of two concurrent compensation rows for one forward step (CompensatesTaskID), exactly one lands. TGS3: the durable A2A store reads a task-graph step's ID as not found and will not write over or cancel it, while an A2A task saves under the 'A2A Task' type and reads back. TGS4: runs a small graph through the real dispatcher on the test DB, asserting that taint from an untrusted action propagates through a Decision step to gate a downstream action, failing the graph and triggering saga compensation of completed compensatable steps.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Envelopes are on every row and immutable; one compensation per forward step; the A2A store touches only A2A Task rows; live dispatcher gates tainted actions downstream of Decision steps and compensates completed steps.
